title: Tragic Midair Helicopter Collision Near Oregon Airport Leaves 3 Dead
snippet: A devastating midair crash involving two helicopters near McMinnville, Oregon, resulted in the deaths of three individuals, including a Texas flight instructor and a U.K. student pilot.
content:
A tragic midair collision between two helicopters in rural Oregon has claimed three lives, local authorities confirmed following a devastating Thursday afternoon crash near McMinnville, located roughly 40 miles southwest of Portland.

Details of the Collision

The Yamhill County Sheriff's Office reported that the incident occurred around 2:10 p.m. near the intersection of Highway 33 and Cruickshank Road. Witness reports indicate the two aircraft collided in flight before coming down in an open field near the highway. Responding first responders located the wreckage of both a 1995 Robinson R22 and a 2018 Airbus AS350B3.

Victims Identified

Officials confirmed that the Robinson R22 was carrying 22-year-old flight instructor Maddie Aasbo, a Texas native, alongside a student pilot from the United Kingdom. The student's identity is currently being withheld while local authorities work alongside the FBI and international consulate officials to notify next of kin. The sole pilot aboard the Airbus AS350B3 was identified as Tyler Delane Sturdevant, 38, of nearby Newberg, Oregon.

Federal Investigation Launched

Both the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) rushed to the scene to initiate a full inquiry. The NTSB is taking the lead on investigating the sequence of events and factors that led to the fatal crash.
